feeds.title: Beautiful Flower Pictures Blog
feeds.description: Beautiful Flower Pictures is a photography blog founded by Patty Hankins and Bill Lawrence, based in the Washington, DC area. Patty, who focuses primarily on photographing flowers, and Bill, who specializes in landscapes, use their blog to share their recent work and provide updates on their photography adventures. The site also features their photos available for purchase and information about their techniques and processes...
